annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that a client may only include an HTTP-date in an If-Range header if it has no entity-tag for the representation and the date qualifies as a strong validator per Section 8.8.2.2; otherwise it must not. No alternative reasonable interpretations or missing constraints are evident.
